resource.name: hr-entity-service
resource.description: Employees with their business unit, department, team and company placement, reporting lines, employment status and final day of employment, and the organization structure with its countries; read only for this product.
resource.provider: the organization's HR entity service, backed by the HR information system

config.description: Client id for the client-credentials grant
Client secret for the client-credentials grant
Token address for the client-credentials grant
Address of the service's GraphQL interface

resource.consumptionInstructions: Authenticate with OAuth2 client credentials against the token address and send the bearer token with every GraphQL request. Three queries: `employees(filter, limit, offset)` for staff by employee status, excluded employment types and unit, paged by `limit` and `offset` until an empty page; `employee(email)` for one person's placement, final day of employment and reporting lead, where `reportsToEmail` is null when no lead is recorded; and `orgData(employeeStatuses)` for the organization tree three levels deep with the level count, the countries and a flat list of paths. Employees are identified by work email. The service fronts the HR information system; callers never reach it directly.
